name: nexo
description: Nexo — panel unico y suite de modulos internos de Materiales J Castillo (estilo Odoo)

scripts.build: node scripts/check-app-tasks.mjs build && turbo run build
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-app-tasks.mjs lint && turbo run lint
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/check-app-tasks.mjs typecheck && turbo run typecheck
scripts.test:db: pnpm run test:rrhh:p1 && pnpm run test:rrhh:compartido
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint:gate && pnpm run lint:self-test && pnpm run test:db && pnpm run test:agencia:access && pnpm run build
